review_notes: Reviewed all 119 lines, the underlying graph definitions, related GraphDomain proofs, and relevant Mathlib measurability lemmas. The proposed replacement was not compiled.

findings.excerpt:
have h₁ : Measurable (fun G : GraphCode => G.1) := measurable_subtype_coe
  have h₂ : Measurable (fun G : GraphCode => G.1 u) :=
    (measurable_pi_apply u).comp h₁
  have h₃ : Measurable (fun G : GraphCode => G.1 u v) :=
    (measurable_pi_apply v).comp h₂
  exact h₃.eq_const true
findings.problem: Two intermediate facts manually express coordinate evaluation, for which Mathlib provides the directly named Measurable.eval lemma.
findings.proposed_change:
Replace the proof with:
by
  have h : Measurable (fun G : GraphCode => G.1 u v) :=
    (measurable_subtype_coe.eval (a := u)).eval (a := v)
  exact h.eq_const true
findings.benefit: Removes bookkeeping while explicitly retaining the mathematical steps: evaluate the two coordinates, then test equality with true. The argument still applies unchanged when u = v.

evidence.excerpt:
theorem Measurable.eval {a : δ} {g : α → ∀ a, X a} (hg : Measurable g) :
    Measurable fun x => g x a :=
  (measurable_pi_apply a).comp hg

theorem measurable_subtype_coe {p : α → Prop} : Measurable ((↑) : Subtype p → α) :=
  MeasurableSpace.le_map_comap

lemma Measurable.eq_const {_ : MeasurableSpace α} [MeasurableSpace β] [MeasurableSingletonClass β]
    {f : α → β} (hf : Measurable f) (a : β) : Measurable fun x => f x = a :=
def Adj (G : GraphCode) (u v : ℕ) : Prop := G.1 u v = true
